title: U.S. Treasury Cuts Off MEXC From U.S. Financial System Over Alleged $16 Billion in Illicit Flows
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

U.S. Treasury Cuts Off MEXC From U.S. Financial System Over Alleged $16 Billion in Illicit Flows

FinCEN issued a final order under section 9714(a) that will bar U.S. financial institutions from sending or receiving funds with MEXC Global 30 days after Federal Register publication, citing at least $16 billion in alleged illicit activity.

This post U.S. Treasury Cuts Off MEXC From U.S. Financial System Over Alleged $16 Billion in Illicit Flows first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.

title: Former FBI Agent Pleads Guilty to Stealing $2.47 Million in Crypto From Investigations
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

Former FBI Agent Pleads Guilty to Stealing $2.47 Million in Crypto From Investigations

Patrick Steven Yaroch, 37, of Ashburn, Virginia, pleaded guilty Thursday to wire fraud and money laundering after using wallet credentials from 35 FBI investigations to take about $2.47 million in cryptocurrency.

This post Former FBI Agent Pleads Guilty to Stealing $2.47 Million in Crypto From Investigations first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.

title: Rule to Allow Crypto in 401(k)s Arrives at White House for Final Review
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

Rule to Allow Crypto in 401(k)s Arrives at White House for Final Review

A final Labor Department rule that would create a fiduciary safe harbor for private equity, real estate and crypto in 401(k) menus arrived at OIRA on Thursday, putting public release within reach.

This post Rule to Allow Crypto in 401(k)s Arrives at White House for Final Review first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.
